description: keep_forever stops Drive pruning a revision of a file with bytes. published puts a Doc, Sheet or deck revision on the web for anyone at its publishedLink (publish_auto follows later revisions, published_outside_domain lets people outside the domain read it): only on the user's explicit go.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.

name: update_revision
title: Keep or publish a revision
